integrity: An all-order combinatorial proof is supplied. Two independent exhaustive programs and an explicit geodesic-construction program were executed and agree with the claimed finite ranges. Finite checks do not replace the proof; independent review remains unperformed.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted labelled simple cycles only; 2 <= k < n, ceil(n/k) <= t <= n; token sliding, not jumping. The median formula applies only for kt>n and t<n; the divisibility boundary kt=n is disconnected and t=n is singleton. Priority under alternative bounded-gap exclusion terminology has not been independently established.
title: Isometric token sliding for cyclic \(k\)-path vertex covers
